description: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM 7.x) REST API. All calls go through /webapi/entry.cgi with api, method, and version query parameters. Auth uses session-based SID tokens.

env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_DSM_SIDCOOKIE
env_var_specs.description: DSM session cookie in format 'id=<SID>'. Obtain via Login tool.

tools.name: Login
tools.description: Log in and obtain a DSM session ID (SID). Save the returned sid with auth set-token id=<SID_VALUE>.

tools.name: Logout
tools.description: Log out and invalidate the current session.

tools.name: GetDSMInfo
tools.description: Get DSM system information — model, version, uptime, CPU.

tools.name: GetSystemUtilization
tools.description: Get real-time CPU, memory, network, and disk utilization.

params.name: type
params.description: Resource sample type: current or history

tools.name: ListBackupTasks
tools.description: List all Hyper Backup tasks with schedule and destination info.

tools.name: GetBackupTask
tools.description: Get details for a specific Hyper Backup task.

tools.name: GetBackupTaskStatus
tools.description: Get current status and progress of a Hyper Backup task.

tools.name: RunBackupTask
tools.description: Trigger an immediate Hyper Backup for a task.

tools.name: CancelBackupTask
tools.description: Cancel an in-progress Hyper Backup task.

tools.name: ListBackupRepositories
tools.description: List all Hyper Backup repositories (destinations).

tools.name: ListStorageDisks
tools.description: List all disks with health status, temperature, and SMART indicators.

tools.name: GetStorageDisk
tools.description: Get detailed information for a specific disk including SMART data.

tools.name: ListStoragePools
tools.description: List all storage pools (RAID groups) with health and usage.

tools.name: ListStorageVolumes
tools.description: List all storage volumes with usage and mount point.

tools.name: GetStorageVolume
tools.description: Get details for a specific volume.

tools.name: ListScheduledTasks
tools.description: List all Task Scheduler tasks with schedule and enable status.

tools.name: GetScheduledTask
tools.description: Get configuration for a specific scheduled task.

tools.name: RunScheduledTask
tools.description: Run a scheduled task immediately.

tools.name: SetScheduledTaskEnabled
tools.description: Enable or disable a scheduled task.

params.name: enable
params.description: true to enable, false to disable

tools.name: DeleteScheduledTask
tools.description: Delete a scheduled task permanently.

tools.name: ListContainers
tools.description: List all Docker containers with running status and image.

tools.name: GetContainer
tools.description: Get detailed configuration and status for a specific container.

tools.name: StartContainer
tools.description: Start a stopped container.

tools.name: StopContainer
tools.description: Stop a running container gracefully.

tools.name: RestartContainer
tools.description: Restart a container (stop then start).

tools.name: GetContainerLogs
tools.description: Get recent log output from a container.

tools.name: ListContainerImages
tools.description: List all downloaded Docker images.

tools.name: GetFileStationInfo
tools.description: Get File Station capabilities and hostname.

tools.name: ListSharedFolders
tools.description: List all shared folders visible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: ListFiles
tools.description: List files and directories in a folder path.

tools.name: GetFileInfo
tools.description: Get metadata for specific files or directories.
